relevance_rank_note: APOE3 vs APOE4 knock-in mouse primary neurons: EEA1 early-endosome number and size unchanged at 18 and 25-26 days in vitro; three-group tests only (with ApoE KO), no pairwise E4 vs E3 statistic; class 3 nulls.

description: AGAINST (null): at 18 days in vitro, the number of EEA1+ early endosomes per neuronal cell body did not differ between ApoE KO, APOE3 and APOE4 knock-in neurons. The paper prints group means (APOE3 120, APOE4 106 puncta per cell body) and a one-way ANOVA across ApoE KO, APOE3 and APOE4 (p = 0.572), but no APOE4 vs APOE3 test or percent.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in EEA1 early-endosome number, neuronal cell bodies, 18 days) [AGAINST]
system: Mouse primary cortical/hippocampal neuron-enriched cultures from E15-17 embryos of ApoE KO (B6.129P2-Apoe tm1Unc/J), APOE3 knock-in (B6.Cg-Apoe em2(APOE*)Adiuj/J) and APOE4 knock-in (B6(SJL)-Apoe tm1.1(APOE*4)Adiuj/J) mice (all Jackson Laboratory), 18 days in vitro; EEA1 immunostaining with MAP2, number of EEA1+ puncta in neuronal cell bodies, 6-10 fields per embryo. Mouse embryonic neurons with endogenous human APOE knock-in; the APOE3 and APOE4 lines were made differently (CRISPR vs gene targeting).
human_check: No pairwise E4 vs E3 test: the only statistic is the one-way ANOVA across KO, E3 and E4 (p = 0.572); no post hoc test was run because the omnibus test was not significant, and the panel has no bracket (Fig 1C image checked). P set to N/A. Printed means: KO 123, E3 120, E4 106 puncta per cell body (mean). Effect N/A because no E4 vs E3 percent is printed (not converted).
